title: fix(app-shell,plugin-detail): ask a record verdict only where a button uses it (objectui#13045)
body:
Fixes #13045
Clause-②: no

## What changes

A record page no longer asks `POST /api/v1/security/explain` for a verdict nothing on screen uses.

- **`RecordDetailView` header (`@object-ui/app-shell`).** The `update` verdict is not asked when the object's `userActions.edit` is the static `false`, and the `delete` verdict is not asked when `userActions.delete` is the static `false`. The hook's existing `enabled` argument carries this, read from the same `objectDef.userActions` entry the header gate (`resolveRecordHeaderActionGates`) reads. A per-record predicate form, `true`, or an absent entry still asks, and Edit and Delete still follow the verdict.
- **`DetailView` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`).** Seat ruling A (comment 6267444006). Each verdict is asked only when the host shows its button: `update` only with `showEdit`, `delete` only with `showDelete`, read from the same `gatedSchema` the buttons read. The console record page's `record:details` body shows neither button. Its two asks used to join the header's in-flight request (objectui#11699), so with only the header change they went out on their own and the measured count did not drop (os-dev report 6267417403).

`askVerdict`'s fetch, cache and fail-open contract are unchanged. No export, prop or type member is added.

## Pins

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.hiddenAffordanceVerdicts-13045.test.tsx` mounts the real page (synthesized, so its `record:details` body is mounted) over the real verdict hook and counts explain requests by operation:
  - (a) `edit: false, delete: false`: no request.
  - (b) `delete: false` alone: only `update` is asked, and it still gates Edit, in both the deny and the allow direction.
  - (c) CONTROL, with `userActions` absent, `true` or in predicate form: both are asked, and a denying or allowing verdict hides or offers both affordances.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.verdictOnlyForShownButton-13045.test.tsx`:
  - A standalone `DetailView` with `showEdit` / `showDelete` asks both, and its buttons follow the verdict (deny and allow).
  - With one button shown, only that verdict is asked. With neither shown, nothing is asked.
- `DetailView.test.tsx` › "probes the record-level explain endpoint for update and delete, and nothing else" now sets `showEdit` / `showDelete`, since without them nothing is asked by design.

## Ablation (once per term, each restored and proven by blob hash)

All files resolve through the vitest `src` alias, so no build sits between a mutation and a run. Each leg checked its anchor on disk before running, then restored with `git checkout HEAD -- ABS_PATH`. After each restore `git diff HEAD` was empty and the disk `hash-object` matched the HEAD blob.

  - app-shell family (every test that imports `RecordDetailView`; 126 files in three runs): 43 + 42 + 41 files passed, 335 + 295 + 255 tests.

The root `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project`, so with no type-aware linting this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it did not touch. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- Pre-tsc battery, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, and `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`.

Changeset: `.changeset/13045-skip-hidden-verdicts.md`, with `@object-ui/app-shell` patch and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

## Acceptance notes

- The ruling covers the static boolean `false` only. An object-form entry `{ enabled: false }` with no predicate also hides the affordance, but it still asks, as ruled ("non-boolean still asks").
